rules.sentence: Myeloma: This must be a consideration in the differential for individuals greater than 40 years.
Myelomas demonstrate multiple punched-out lesions on CT; this does not show any uptake on bone scans.
Infection: Bone infection, or osteomyelitis, is a great mimicker of the tumor.
It can present anywhere in the bone.
Hyperparathyroidism or Brown tumor: Brown tumor can occur in any bone and present as multiple osteolytic lesions.
